=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1582,1649 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The cache `path` is hardcoded to `.ai/review_issue_ledger`, so `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH` overrides outside that directory (including the legacy `.ai/review_issue_ledger.txt`) are not restored or saved across iterations.
  WHY: All reviewers identified the same backward-compatibility regression; severity differs only by reviewer, so the highest severity is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1582 and 1649 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Cache `path` hardcodes `.ai/review_issue_ledger` directory only, breaking backward compatibility for legacy `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH=.ai/review_issue_ledger.txt` overrides.
  WHY: When `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH` is overridden to `.ai/review_issue_ledger.txt`, the cache restore/save steps won't persist that file across iterations because it's outside the cached directory.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The cache configuration hardcodes the new directory `.ai/review_issue_ledger`, but user overrides like the legacy `.ai/review_issue_ledger.txt` are not cached.
  WHY: If a consumer repository has `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH` set to a file outside the `.ai/review_issue_ledger/` directory, the `actions/cache` steps will skip it and the ledger state will be lost between autofix iterations.
- `scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: There is a directory-guard concern around the legacy path handling.
  WHY: The mismatch between the workflow's cache `path` (directory-only) and the script's flexibility is the root cause of the persistence failure identified in the first issue.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Hardcoded cache path excludes legacy lidger files.
  WHY: The suggested fix is to use a more inclusive path list covering both the directory and the legacy file location.
- `scripts/review_commit_changes.sh` | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: Redundant hardcoded default path calculation.
  WHY: Relying on an environment variable passed from the workflow or the central ledger script would reduce the risk of the detector getting out of sync.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: Missing explicit directory creation for the cache target.
  WHY: Adding `mkdir -p .ai/review_issue_ledger` would ensure the directory exists before cache/script interaction in fresh environments.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:15,582 and 16,649 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The cache `path` is hardcoded to `.ai/review_issue_ledger`, which only covers the new per-PR ledger directory and breaks the documented legacy single-file override.
  WHY: `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH` respects overrides, but the cache restore/save operations ignore them and only persist `.ai/review_issue_ledger/`, so legacy override users lose cross-iteration ledger persistence.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` (cache restore step and save step) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When a consumer repository overrides `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH` to the legacy single-file path, the cache only restores/saves `.ai/review_issue_ledger/`, not the sibling file.
  WHY: The workflow caches a static directory while the scripts consume `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH`, so the overridden ledger is not persisted between iterations.
- `scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh` line 700 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The script supports a configurable ledger path, but the cache path is static.
  WHY: With `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH=.ai/review_issue_ledger.txt`, the script writes to that file while cache operations ignore it, so state resets every run.
- `README.md` line 988 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Consumers overriding `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH` are not told cache persistence is disabled.
  WHY: The documentation should note that explicit override to the legacy single-file path disables `actions/cache` persistence and causes ledger resets each iteration.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: No cache hit/miss visibility is logged.
  WHY: Adding a cache-hit log after restore would make it easier to see whether the ledger was restored or started fresh.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The cache `path` is hardcoded to `.ai/review_issue_ledger`, but `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH` determines the actual ledger location.
  WHY: When `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH` is overridden to the legacy single-file path or any location outside `.ai/review_issue_ledger`, the ledger is neither restored from the previous iteration nor saved for the next iteration.
=== END FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
